context: Today's momentum turned positive but printed a REJECTION on top of it, after a retracement. The market has been negative for many days, so sellers MAY now be seated -- and only a gap up would prove it.
plan: THIRD DAY RUNNING ON THE SAME CONDITIONAL SHAPE: gap up -> BUY, flat or gap down -> SELL, for all three indices. What changes each day is the REASON, and today it is whether a multi-day negative run has finally seated sellers.

FLAT OR GAP DOWN -> SELL, going WITH the market. On NIFTY he gives that branch its premise outright -- 'sellers are not much seated here' -- so there is nobody to squeeze and the plan is simply to follow the selling.

GAP UP -> BUY, and only a gap up makes those sellers real: 'because the market has been negative for many days, there COULD be sellers here, so in a gap-up case they can be targeted'. Absent the gap they stay hypothetical.

TODAY'S SHAPE IS RETRACEMENT THEN REJECTION -- 'momentum turned positive but a rejection also formed' -- which is exactly why the seated question is left OPEN for the open to answer rather than settled in advance.
